decisions.reason: Because it had dedicated web pages in both 2018 and 2019 and fits the firm's core drainage portfolio, management is likely to justify its prior investment and continue with it unless failure is unmistakable.

Its move from a mention to a dedicated page suggests rising commitment in a core shower-drainage segment, so management would be inclined to persist and attribute any weak uptake to a still-maturing market.

Although its visibility fell from a dedicated page to a mere mention, it remains close to the firm's shower-drainage strategy, making management somewhat reluctant to abandon a publicly introduced design product.
With only limited website visibility in both observed years and less explicit public commitment, this product is easier for management to cut despite some fit with the shower system range.
This product received the strongest public launch language and home-page promotion, so escalation of commitment strongly favors continuing with it as an important, visibly backed innovation.
As a product that was only ever mentioned and appears less central to the firm's most visible drainage innovations, it has the weakest commitment base and is the easiest to discontinue.
